Withholding tax receipt — Edit

The Withholding Tax Receipt form is used to record tax withheld on behalf of customers.

This documents tax amounts that have been withheld and will be remitted to tax authorities.

This form contains the following fields:

Date

Enter the date of the withholding tax receipt. This is typically when the customer withheld the tax.

Customer

Select the customer who withheld tax from their payment. This links the receipt to the customer's account.

Amount

Enter the amount of tax withheld by the customer. This creates a receivable that can offset your tax liabilities.

Exchange rate

If the customer uses a foreign currency, enter the exchange rate to convert to your base currency.

Description

Optionally, add a description for this withholding tax receipt, such as invoice references or tax certificate numbers.
